implementation.targetScope: FuseCountdown: strict ISO/local dates and exact instants, calendar-day addition, elapsed-second differences and fixed-unit duration fields. Formatting, locale data, calendar months/years, timezone modes and plugins are outside scope.

changes: Zero runtime dependencies and no upstream runtime copied.
Native Date storage with explicit ISO validation; no ambiguous host-dependent string parser fallback.
Calendar-day additions preserve local clock time across DST; hour/second differences remain elapsed time. Clones and returned Dates own their data.

Day/week durations preserve a separate calendar bucket, so fractional days do not become elapsed-hour component fields; signed zero and large finite component arithmetic match current and app controls.

caller.scope: Five coming-soon template pages use the date 2071-07-28. This is not the contest timer. The representative countdown tick preserves the caller rounding of asDays(). Release and adoption are separate.
